description: circuit provider: PCBs from UHD board modules with tscircuit, run in-process under Node and offline (generate, export, extract, check).

tools.purpose: tscircuit libraries (@tscircuit/core 0.0.2056 and its converters, exact versions) on Node 22+, run in Protoboard's process; no tsci, no Bun, no account
tools.install: npm install @protoboardai/ext-tscircuit (its package.json pins every tscircuit package)

tools.purpose: KiCad 10's command line: saves the exported KiCad project in KiCad 10's format, and makes a locked board's fabrication outputs (DRC, Gerber, drill, position, STEP, GLB)
tools.install: install KiCad 10 (kicad.org/download); on Linux the distribution's kicad package, on macOS the KiCad app (its kicad-cli is in KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS; set PROTOBOARD_KICAD_CLI to it)

skills.summary: Design a custom PCB through the circuit capability: the board as a UHD module, circuit.config.ts, circuit:generate/export/extract/check, and what each CIRCUIT_* finding means
Review and finish a locked board's layout in KiCad 10: what to check, DRC/ERC reports, Update PCB from Schematic keeping placement, and acting on CIRCUIT_KICAD_* findings
kicad-cli exports and checks for a KiCad 10 project (DRC, ERC, Gerber, drill, position, STEP/GLB, SVG/PDF, netlist, BOM, upgrade), and the fallback before lock

capabilities.summary: PCBs from UHD boards with tscircuit: generated source, local autorouting, Gerber/BOM/PnP/GLB/STEP/manifest/netlist and SVG renders, DRC and netlist drift

generate.summary: Write tscircuit/board.gen.tsx from the UHD board and circuit.config.ts, then build and route it locally (circuit.json)

force.description: true: generate a locked board anyway (rebuilds tscircuit's copy; KiCad stays the layout of record)

export.summary: Write the standard outputs to out/ (rebuilding first if the native source changed); a locked board's come from KiCad (kicad-cli)

force.description: true: a locked board's export goes on despite KiCad DRC errors

extract.summary: Frames of the board's exports and interfaces, placements and outline, artifact references

check.summary: tscircuit DRC, netlist drift against the UHD board, unrouted nets, outline, keep-outs and fixed placements; on a locked board, the model, the handoff record and the KiCad files compared

kicad.summary: A KiCad 10 project of the current build in tscircuit/kicad/ (a preview; tscircuit stays the layout of record)

lock.summary: Hand the board to KiCad: the KiCad 10 project into <board>/kicad/ with handoff.json; KiCad is then the layout of record (a human decision: agents ask first)

refresh.description: true on a locked board: re-record the handoff from the model and the KiCad files as they are now, without exporting

unlock.summary: Return a locked board to tscircuit: kicad/ moves to kicad-archive/<stamp>/ (a human decision: agents ask first)

outline.description: { circle: { diameter_mm } } | { rect: { width_mm, height_mm } } | { polygon: [[x, y], …] } (mm, board frame); default: the board's design_envelope

placements.description: { <instance>: { at: [x, y], rotation_deg, side } }: positions the enclosure fixes (connectors, buttons, displays, sensor windows)

keepouts.description: [{ name, rect: { at, size } | circle: { at, diameter_mm }, layers?, reason?, allow_bodies? }] copper keep-outs (an antenna clearance); allow_bodies names parts whose body may lie over it (the module whose antenna it clears)

pours.description: [{ net, layers: (top|bottom|inner1|inner2)[], clearance_mm?, reason? }] copper pours (a ground plane), filled after routing around other nets' copper and outside the keep-outs

rules.description: { trace_width_mm, power_trace_width_mm, via_drill_mm, via_pad_mm, edge_clearance_mm, hole_clearance_mm? }; hole_clearance_mm: least copper-to-hole distance for non-plated holes (check tests round holes as circles)

autorouter.description: local tscircuit autorouter preset: auto_local (default) or sequential_trace; cloud routing is refused

copper_oz.description: outer copper weight for the fabrication order (default: the fab's standard, 1 oz)

finish.description: surface finish for the fabrication order, e.g. ENIG or lead-free HASL (default: ENIG when a part is leadless, else lead-free HASL)

solder_mask.description: solder mask colour for the fabrication order (default green)

silkscreen.description: silkscreen colour for the fabrication order (default white)

assembly.description: fab (default: the fab places from pnp.csv) or hand

fab_notes.description: [string] notes the fabrication order gives the fab, numbered (e.g. fill and cap vias in pads, IPC-4761 type VII; a hold before ordering)

via_in_pad.description: vias inside SMD pads: avoid (default; check reports any as an error) or fill_and_cap (allowed; the fabrication order asks for filled and capped vias, IPC-4761 type VII)

via_touching_pad.description: vias whose ring touches or overlaps an SMD pad without sitting in it: avoid (check reports each as an error) or allow (default)

via_under_body.description: vias under a component's body (inside its courtyard): avoid (check reports each as an error) or allow (default)

routing.description: on (default: the local autorouter routes every net) or off (placement only: no autorouting; check reports unrouted nets as info)

trace_widths.description: { nets?: { <UHD net id>: mm }, classes?: { signal?, power?, ground?: mm } } trace width per net, else per net class, else the rules' widths; check reports a net routed narrower

artifacts.name: Build record (tscircuit names and UHD instances)
KiCad project (the layout of record while locked)

operations.summary: Manufacturing Package: each board's fabrication and assembly order (layers, thickness, copper, finish, mask, stack-up, assembly sides, leadless parts, files)
